narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I will write two, three, six and seven in Roman symbols, side by side.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Roman symbols have no places. All the symbols in a row are added together.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>His row adds up to only eighteen, so it cannot be the right numeral.
